research_limitations: No Porsche mesh, local source file or user-computer data was inspected by this lane.
No measurements were inferred from an uncalibrated photograph or catalogue illustration.
No software was run, no purchases made, no external messages sent and no files uploaded.
Shared-workspace Markdown and JSON were authored as the requested research handoff.
Full SAE 920789 and full ISO standards were not accessed; catalogue/abstract access is distinguished.
No open-licensed dimensionally validated Porsche target rotor CAD was found in inspected sources.
A porschefanatics reconstruction project appeared in search and was excluded as independent corroboration.
Negative search findings are bounded to this pass and do not establish universal nonexistence.
